top_signals.title: Boomer Candy Leads To Boomer Cavities: Huszczo
top_signals.summary: Sam Huszczo, founder & CIO of SGH Wealth Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discuss how investors might be getting a bit overconfident amid this bull market. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
